mission: TinyJS M2 packaging, installer and installed-product acceptance

gates.note: PyInstaller 6.22.3 onedir sidecar; shell resolves resources/sidecar; no repo .venv or BORS_PYTHON in installed runs.
Real cached market board, chart switch W/raw/آباد, FTS/fundamental card, market status, company name. Cold 2/3 and warm 3/3 reached all stages; one cold run failed a lazy chunk import.
13 live executions x 5 cases = 65/65 pass; Origin: null always 403; no guard change.
Shell exit 0, port closed, 0 survivors after a 30s grace in close tests. Earlier 1s checks saw 1-3 WebView2 processes in 3/9 full runs; those were force-killed, natural exit not measured.
Root killed after full load: exit 1, no survivors, port closed; restart on the same work dir passed all stages.
Sidecar killed while live: visible startup-failed window captured; shell exit 0, port closed; two WebView2 processes exited naturally in 1.1s.
No makensis/ISCC/candle/light; only iexpress and makecab. NSIS/WiX/system-wide install was not authorized; no installer was built or run.
No real installer, so install/uninstall/reinstall gates are blocked. Portable relocation and clean removal of the folder are the only tested deployment.
Get-AuthenticodeSignature: NotSigned for shell, launcher and sidecar. No signtool/osslsigncode; no certificate or private key was read.
No WebView2 bootstrapper is shipped; host runtime 155.0.4283.62 is required.
Removing the system WebView2 runtime is a destructive system-wide change and was not authorized; behavior on a runtime-less machine is unmeasured.
Real tiny.app.update.check over loopback: 0.3.0 -> 0.3.1 available; notes delivered.
The Windows swap failed: resources/sidecar/_internal/base_library.zip is held by the running PyInstaller sidecar (EBUSY). The app remained at 0.3.0.
After the failed swap TinyJS rolled back: changed_count 0, no .update-old files, version_after 0.3.0.
A 0.3.2 manifest with a wrong sha256 was refused with 'checksum mismatch'; changed_count 0.
Only an unsigned loopback manifest was tested; no HTTPS release feed and no Ed25519 signed manifest/public key.
Cold n=3 and warm n=3; p95 not reported for n<20. Package 201.2 MiB; first-run data 269.1 MiB; total 470.3 MiB; update zip 130.9 MiB.
First-run extraction leaves market.db.part-shm (32 KB) and market.db.part-wal (0 B) in the data dir; no process/port leaks.
1/3 cold runs failed a TechnicalPage dynamic import in WebView2 even though the server logged 200; warm and close runs did not reproduce it.
No production module changed; the full suite was not rerun in M2. M1.5 baseline: 2,090 tests, 2,074 pass / 11 pre-existing failures / 5 skip.
All M2 runs used isolated BORS_WORK_DIR/BORS_DB. Operational market.db, WAL and user.db hashes are unchanged.

blockers: No authorized Windows installer toolchain (NSIS/WiX/ISCC absent).
No code-signing tool or authorized certificate; all binaries are unsigned.
No WebView2 bootstrapper; missing-runtime behavior unmeasured.
In-app update cannot replace a running PyInstaller sidecar tree (base_library.zip lock).
